dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 05, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Giants Blow Out Cubs 18-3 Behind Chapman's Record-Breaking Performance**

The San Francisco Giants delivered an impressive 18-3 thrashing of the Chicago Cubs, led by Matt Chapman's incredible outing. Chapman went yard twice, collected a league-leading 8 RBIs, and reached base in all three of his at-bats, capping off an incredible performance. Robbie Ray earned the win, pitching 5 scoreless innings with 4 strikeouts. Edward Cabrera took the loss for the Cubs.

**Tigers Down Mariners 7-3 Behind Valdez's Strong Start**

The Detroit Tigers edged out the Seattle Mariners 7-3, with Framber Valdez shining on the mound. Valdez pitched 5 innings, allowing just 1 earned run and striking out 5. Kerry Carpenter went yard for the Tigers, driving in 2 runs. Bryan Woo took the loss for the Mariners.

**Phillies Take Down White Sox 8-6 in Thrilling Contest**

The Philadelphia Phillies took down the Chicago White Sox 8-6, behind Randal Grichuk's 2-home run, 2-RBI performance. Jonathan Bowlan earned the win, while Jhoan Duran secured the save for the Phillies. Bryce Harper scored on a sacrifice fly to left field, securing the win for Philadelphia.

**Red Sox Outlast Yankees 5-3 Behind Contreras' Clutch Hit**

The Boston Red Sox edged out the New York Yankees 5-3, with Willson Contreras going yard for the Red Sox. Sonny Gray earned the win, while Aroldis Chapman secured the save for Boston. Trent Grisham also went yard for the Red Sox, driving in 1 run.

**Orioles Cruise Past Blue Jays 13-3 Behind Rutschman's Dominant Performance**

The Baltimore Orioles cruised to a 13-3 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, led by Adley Rutschman's 4-hit, 5-RBI performance. Rutschman reached base in all four of his at-bats, capping off an incredible performance. Brandon Young earned the win for the Orioles.

**Rays Shut Down Marlins 6-0 Behind Rasmussen's Stellar Start**

The Tampa Bay Rays shut down the Miami Marlins 6-0, with Drew Rasmussen dominating on the mound. Rasmussen pitched 7 scoreless innings, striking out 9 and allowing just 1 hit. Cedric Mullins went yard for the Rays, driving in 1 run.

**Braves Edge Out Pirates 6-3 Behind Dubón's Home Run**

The Atlanta Braves edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-3, with Mauricio Dubón going yard for the Braves. Martín Pérez earned the win, while Raisel Iglesias secured the save for Atlanta. Austin Riley doubled for the Braves, driving in 1 run.

**Astros Shut Down Athletics 5-1 Behind Paredes' Clutch Hit**

The Houston Astros shut down the Oakland Athletics 5-1, with Isaac Paredes going yard for the Astros. Peter Lambert earned the win, while Mason Barnett pitched 4 scoreless innings in relief.

**Cardinals Rout Reds 10-3 Behind Burleson's Home Run**

The St. Louis Cardinals routed the Cincinnati Reds 10-3, with Alec Burleson going yard for the Cardinals. Hunter Dobbins earned the win, while Jimmy Crooks doubled for the Cardinals, driving in 1 run.

**Rangers Edge Out Guardians 3-2 Behind Seager's Home Run**

The Texas Rangers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 3-2, with Corey Seager going yard for the Rangers. Peyton Gray earned the win, while Jacob Latz secured the save for Texas.

**Twins Take Down Royals 5-3 Behind Lee's Home Run**

The Minnesota Twins took down the Kansas City Royals 5-3, with Brooks Lee going yard for the Twins. Zebby Matthews earned the win, while Travis Adams secured the save for Minnesota.

**Brewers Edge Out Rockies 9-7 Behind Goodman's Home Run**

The Milwaukee Brewers edged out the Colorado Rockies 9-7, with Hunter Goodman going yard for the Brewers. Trevor Megill earned the win, while Craig Yoho pitched 2 scoreless innings in relief.

**Nationals Rout Diamondbacks 14-1 Behind García's Dominant Performance**

The Washington Nationals routed the Arizona Diamondbacks 14-1, with Luis García Jr. going yard twice and driving in 6 runs. Foster Griffin earned the win, while Merrill Kelly took the loss for the Diamondbacks.

**Mets Shut Down Padres 5-0 Behind Scott's Strong Start**

The New York Mets shut down the San Diego Padres 5-0, with Christian Scott pitching 5.2 scoreless innings. Luis Torrens went yard for the Mets, driving in 2 runs.

**Dodgers Edge Out Angels 1-0 Behind Freeman's Home Run**

The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the Los Angeles Angels 1-0, with Freddie Freeman going yard for the Dodgers. Roki Sasaki pitched 7 scoreless innings for the Angels, striking out 10.
